narrative.overview:
The interface is the palette and type already shipping in the web app. The page is paper, the text is ink, and the face is Arial. Moss is the open action and the focus outline. Ember, gold, and mist mark review priority. Raised surfaces use one soft card shadow.

Home’s two-column desk is that page’s composition. It is not a layout rule for investigation or supplier screens. No named visual metaphor is recorded here, because neither the product commitments nor the tokens name one.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, white cards, ink text
Moss for the open action, record links, and focus
Ember, gold, and mist for priority

rules.name: The Priority Color Rule
rules.body: High priority is ember, medium priority is gold, and no flagged signals is mist with ink text. Moss is not a priority color.

rules.name: The Moss Action Rule
rules.body: The open action, links back to a record, and the page focus outline use moss. Ink is the wordmark, the current nav item, and the decision submit button.

rules.name: The Arial Rule
rules.body: Interface text is Arial, then Helvetica, then sans-serif. Record identifiers may use the browser monospace stack. No other interface face belongs to this system.

rules.name: The Black Title Rule
rules.body: Page titles and section titles are weight 900 with tracking -0.025em. Reading text stays weight 400.

rules.name: The Card Shadow Rule
rules.body: Raised cards and the bar search use the card shadow. It is a soft blur. It is not a hard offset.

dos: Do set the page background to paper and the default text to ink.
Do use Arial, with Helvetica and sans-serif as the fallbacks, for interface text.
Do raise cards and the bar search with the card shadow.
Do color high priority ember, medium priority gold, and no flagged signals mist with ink text.
Do keep the page focus outline at 2px solid moss, offset 3px.
donts: Don't replace the card shadow with a hard, unblurred offset.
Don't paint the open action in ember. That action is moss.
